sub_sector.value: title insurance and real estate settlement services

financial_business_type.detail: Title insurance underwriter plus escrow, closing and related real estate transaction services.

revenue_driver.detail: Title insurance premiums from direct and agency operations, plus escrow and settlement fees; investment income on float.

customer_type.detail: Home buyers and sellers, agents, lenders, servicers, and commercial real estate parties.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Underwrites title policies and carries claims risk, alongside fee-based escrow and settlement services.
